bib.title: From Local to Global: A GraphRAG Approach to Query-Focused Summarization

question: How can RAG answer global sensemaking questions over an entire text corpus, which vector RAG cannot, at scale?
hypothesis: A graph index with pre-generated community summaries, answered by map-reduce, gives more comprehensive and diverse answers to global questions than vector RAG.
contributions: GraphRAG: LLM-built entity knowledge graph, Leiden community hierarchy, community summaries, map-reduce global answering
LLM-as-judge evaluation for global sensemaking with LLM-generated persona/task/question sets and criteria (comprehensiveness, diversity, empowerment, directness)
Claim-based validation measures (Claimify claims count and clusters)

method.summary: An LLM extracts entities, relationships and claims from 600-token chunks, builds a graph, partitions it hierarchically with Leiden, writes community reports, and at query time map-reduces over shuffled community summaries. Compared with C0-C3 levels, a graph-free map-reduce over source text (TS) and vector RAG (SS) using LLM-judged head-to-head comparisons.
method.task: query-focused summarization / global sensemaking QA over a corpus

datasets.name: Podcast transcripts (Behind the Tech with Kevin Scott)

other.use: indexing, answering, question generation and judging (judge model not separately stated; inferred: same LLM)

inference.samples: each pairwise comparison run 5 times, results averaged; 125 questions per dataset
inference.prompting: entity extraction prompt with domain-tailored few-shot; self-reflection gleaning; community report, map and reduce prompts in App. E
inference.retrieval: SS: text chunks added until 8k token limit; C0-C3: community summaries shuffled into chunks, map answers scored 0-100, score 0 dropped, reduce by descending score

parameters.indexing_time_podcast: 281 minutes on 16GB RAM Intel Xeon Platinum 8171M VM with gpt-4-turbo endpoint (2M TPM, 10k RPM)
parameters.self_reflection: logit bias 100 for yes/no, max iterations specified but value not stated

metrics.name: Win rate (comprehensiveness, diversity, empowerment, directness)
metrics.definition: LLM judge picks winner or tie; win=100, loss=0, tie=50 averaged over 5 runs and 125 questions

metrics.name: Average clusters
metrics.definition: agglomerative complete-linkage clustering of claims, distance 1-ROUGE-L, thresholds 0.5-0.8

eval.protocol: Wilcoxon signed-rank with Holm-Bonferroni correction; LLM judge only, no human judge

availability.data: Podcast public; News is MultiHop-RAG; generated questions not stated as released

prompts.text: ---Role--- You are a helpful assistant responsible for grading two answers to a question that are provided by two different people. ---Goal--- Given a question and two answers (Answer 1 and Answer 2), assess which answer is better according to the following measure: {criteria} ... Winner: either 1 (if Answer 1 is better) and 2 (if Answer 2 is better) or 0 if they are fundamentally similar and the differences are immaterial.

prompts.purpose: Entity extraction, community summary, community answer, global answer
prompts.text: Given a text document that is potentially relevant to this activity and a list of entity types, identify all entities of those types from the text and all relationships among the identified entities.
prompts.where: App. E.1 first sentence of goal; E.2-E.4 prompts also in App. E
